# Gene diversity and Fst enumeration through grenedalf

## Load filtered pool-seq data and packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(emmeans)
library(broom)
library(patchwork)
library(RColorBrewer)

theme_set(theme_cowplot())

FF_genomes_filtered <- readRDS("../../../Big_data/FF_genomes_filtered.RDS")
```

## Process data for grenedalf

```{r}
FF_grene_process <- FF_genomes_filtered %>% 
    dplyr::select(-Nmiss, -REF, -ALT) %>% rename_with(
      # Removes all text after the second underscore,
      # used to remove _G13_sample...
      # this leaves freq_CON1, N_CON1, and so on.
   ~str_replace(., "^([^_]+_[^_]+)_.*$", "\\1"),
    # exlude CHROM and POS columns for this rule
   .cols = !c(CHROM, POS)
   )

```

### Write files to .csv for grenedalf input

```{r}
write_csv(FF_grene_process, "../../../Big_data/FF_grenedalf_input.csv")

```

## Run grenedalf code for gene diversity

```{r}

gdalf_out_path <- "../../../Big_data/grenedalf_diversity_out"

unlink(gdalf_out_path, recursive = TRUE)

dir.create(gdalf_out_path)

grenedalf_diversity_args <- c(
  "diversity",
  "--frequency-table-path", "../../../Big_data/FF_grenedalf_input.csv",
  
  "--pool-sizes", "130",
  "--window-type", "interval",
  "--window-average-policy", "valid-loci",
  "--filter-sample-min-count", "2",
  "--filter-sample-min-read-depth", "4",
  
  "--window-interval-width", "100000",
  "--window-interval-stride", "100000",
  
  "--out-dir", gdalf_out_path
  )

system2(
  command = "/home/srikantv/miniforge3/bin/grenedalf",
  args = grenedalf_diversity_args,
        
  stdout = "../../../Big_data/grenedalf_diversity_out/gdalf_div_log.txt",
  stderr = "../../../Big_data/grenedalf_diversity_out/gdalf_div_errors.txt"
  )
```

### Load and wrangle gene diversity data

```{r}
gene_div_out <- read_csv("../../../Big_data/grenedalf_diversity_out/diversity.csv")

FF_diversity <- gene_div_out %>% 
  dplyr::select(chrom, start, end, total.passed, 
         matches("\\.(passed|theta_pi|theta_watterson|tajimas_d)"))
```

### Plot $\theta_\pi$ measure of average nucleotide diversity (analog of heterozygosity across windows)

```{r}
FF_thetapi <- FF_diversity %>% 
  dplyr::select(chrom, start, end,
    contains("theta_pi")) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = contains(".theta_pi"),
               names_pattern = "(.*)\\.theta_pi",
               names_to = "Population",
               values_to = "theta_pi")

FF_thetapi <- FF_thetapi %>% 
  separate_wider_regex(cols = Population,
  patterns = c("Selection" = ".*", "PopReplicate" = "\\d$")) %>% 
  mutate_at(c("Selection", "PopReplicate"), factor) %>% 
  filter(chrom %in% c("2L", "2R", "3L", "3R", "X")) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(theta_pi)) %>% drop_na()
  
# box plot of all diversity values within a population
thetapi_box <- ggplot(data = FF_thetapi, aes(x = Selection, y = theta_pi, color = Selection)) +
  geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE, alpha = 0.8) + 
  geom_point(aes(shape = PopReplicate), alpha = 0.1,
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  stat_summary(color = 'black', 
    fun = mean, size = 5, shape = '-') +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Selection",
 values = c("CON" = 'steelblue', "FP" = 'firebrick')) +
 scale_shape_manual(name = "Replicate",
 values = c("1" = 15, "2" = 16, "3" = 17, "4" = 18)) +
  labs(y = bquote("Nucleotide diversity (" ~ theta[pi] ~ ")"), shape = "Replicate") + theme_cowplot() 

print(thetapi_box)


```

### t-test of gene diversity per SNP and scanplot of p-values

```{r}
FF_thetapi_test <- FF_thetapi %>% mutate("mid" = (1 + end)/2) %>% 
  unite("wind_ID", chrom, mid, sep = "_", remove = TRUE) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-start, -end)

thetapi_models <- FF_thetapi_test %>% 
  group_by(wind_ID) %>% reframe(
    tidy(anova(lm(theta_pi ~ Selection, data = pick(everything())))),
  ) %>% filter(term == "Selection")

thetapi_models$adjP <- p.adjust(thetapi_models$p.value, method = 'fdr')

ggplot(data = thetapi_models, aes(y = -log10(adjP))) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), color = 'red') +
  labs(y = "-log10(Adjusted P-value)", 
       title = "LM: Gene Diversity") +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank())
```

## Watterson's theta

Estimate of segregating sites, used to calculate mutation rate. Results have no variance, likely because no estimate of Ne was provided.

```{r}
FF_thetaW <- FF_diversity %>% 
  dplyr::select(chrom, start, end,
    contains("theta_watterson")) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = contains(".theta_watterson"),
               names_pattern = "(.*)\\.theta_watterson",
               names_to = "Population",
               values_to = "theta_W")

FF_thetaW <- FF_thetaW %>% 
  separate_wider_regex(cols = Population,
  patterns = c("Selection" = ".*", "PopReplicate" = "\\d$")) %>% 
  mutate_at(c("Selection", "PopReplicate"), factor) %>% 
  filter(chrom %in% c("2L", "2R", "3L", "3R", "X")) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(theta_W)) %>% drop_na()
  
# box plot of all thetaW diversity values within a population
thetaW_box <- ggplot(data = FF_thetaW, aes(x = Selection, y = theta_W, color = Selection)) +
  geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE, alpha = 0.8) + 
  geom_point(aes(shape = PopReplicate), alpha = 0.1,
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  labs(y = bquote("Nucleotide diversity (" ~ theta[W] ~ ")"), shape = "Replicate") + theme_cowplot() 

print(thetaW_box)

# Scan of nucleotide diversity
thetaW_scan <- ggplot(data = FF_thetaW, aes(
  x = start, y = theta_W, color = Selection)) +
  facet_grid(chrom ~ .) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.05)
  
print(thetaW_scan)

# Scan of FP/CON ratio of nucleotide diversity

thetaWratio <- FF_thetaW %>% 
  group_by(chrom, start, end) %>% 
  summarise(mCON = mean(theta_W[Selection == 'CON']),
            mFP = mean(theta_W[Selection == 'FP']),
            RatioFPCON = log2(mFP/mCON))

# Find 1% outliers, merge with thetapiratio
Rlow <- quantile(thetaWratio$RatioFPCON, 0.01)
Rhigh <- quantile(thetaWratio$RatioFPCON, 0.99)

thetaWratio <- thetaWratio %>% 
  mutate(OutlierRatio = RatioFPCON > Rhigh | RatioFPCON < Rlow)

# Scanplot of FP/CON nucleotide diversity ratio
Wratio_scan <- ggplot(data = thetaWratio, aes(x = start, y = RatioFPCON)) +
  facet_grid(.~chrom, scales = 'free_x', space = 'free_x') +
  geom_point(aes(color = OutlierRatio), alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("FALSE" = 'grey30', "TRUE" = 'red'),
    labels = c("FALSE" = NA, "TRUE" = "1% Outlier")) +
  labs(y = bquote("log2(" ~ theta[W] ~ " Ratio (FP/CON))"),
       x = "Window start") + theme_cowplot() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = 'none')
  
print(Wratio_scan)

```

## Run grenedalf for population-pairwise Fst calculation

Hudson's 1992 method of Fst estimation is applied alongside Nei's 1973 Fst estimation. The grenedalf authors cite Bhatia et al. 2013 (Genome Res.) to recommend Hudson's estimator.

### Fst Hudson estimator

```{r}
gdalf_fst_hudson_path <- "../../../Big_data/grenedalf_fsthudson_out"

unlink(gdalf_fst_hudson_path, recursive = TRUE)

dir.create(gdalf_fst_hudson_path)

grenedalf_fsthudson_args <- c(
  "fst",
  "--frequency-table-path", "../../../Big_data/FF_grenedalf_input.csv",
  
  "--pool-sizes", "130",
  
  "--method", "unbiased-hudson",
  
  "--window-type", "interval",
  "--window-average-policy", "valid-loci",
  "--filter-sample-min-count", "2",
  "--filter-sample-min-read-depth", "4",
  
  "--window-interval-width", "100000",
  "--window-interval-stride", "100000",
  
  "--out-dir", gdalf_fst_hudson_path
  )

system2(
  command = "/home/srikantv/miniforge3/bin/grenedalf",
  args = grenedalf_fsthudson_args,
        
  stdout = "../../../Big_data/grenedalf_fsthudson_out/gdalf_fsthudson_log.txt",
  stderr = "../../../Big_data/grenedalf_fsthudson_out/gdalf_fsthudson_errors.txt"
  )
```

### Fst Hudson estimator data load, wrangle and plot

```{r}
fsthudson_out <- read_csv("../../../Big_data/grenedalf_fsthudson_out/fst.csv")

FF_FstHudson <- fsthudson_out %>% 
  dplyr::select(chrom, start, end, total.passed,
         matches("\\.(passed|fst)"))

FF_FstHudson <- FF_FstHudson %>% pivot_longer(
  cols = contains(":"),
  
  names_to = c("Focal_pop", "Comp_pop", ".value"),
  
  names_pattern = "(.*?):(.*?)\\.(.*)"
)

# Remove any negative Fst values generated due to combinations of very low read depth reads and high allele frequency differences.
FF_FstHudson <- FF_FstHudson %>% filter(fst >= 0)

# if warning appears, it may be due to some SNPs not being passed (check missing or numeric columns in data). This would be due to the singleton/min.read depth filters applied in input.
if (identical(FF_FstHudson$total.passed, FF_FstHudson$passed)){
  FF_FstHudson <- FF_FstHudson %>% dplyr::select(-total.passed)
} else {
  warning("Mismatch between passed values (total vs. specific comparison")
}

FF_FstHudson <- FF_FstHudson %>% 
  filter(chrom %in% c("2L", "2R", "3L", "3R", "X")) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(fst))

Summary_FstHudson <- FF_FstHudson %>% group_by(Focal_pop, Comp_pop) %>% 
  summarise(mean_fst = mean(fst), median_fst = median(fst))

all_pops <- sort(unique(c(as.character(Summary_FstHudson$Focal_pop), as.character(Summary_FstHudson$Comp_pop))))

FstHudson_heatmap_data <- Summary_FstHudson %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(
    Focal_pop = factor(Focal_pop, levels = all_pops),
    Comp_pop = factor(Comp_pop, levels = all_pops),
  ) %>% 
  
  complete(Focal_pop, Comp_pop) %>% 
  
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(mean_fst, median_fst),
    names_to = "Measure",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    Focal_sel = gsub("[0-9]+$", "", as.character(Focal_pop)),
    Comp_sel = gsub("[0-9]+$", "", as.character(Comp_pop)),
    
    Comparison = case_when(
      Focal_pop == Comp_pop ~ "Self",
      is.na(Value) ~ "Unmeasured",
      Focal_sel == Comp_sel ~ "Within",
      TRUE ~ "Between"
    )
  )

FF_FstHudson_mean <- FstHudson_heatmap_data %>% filter(Measure == "mean_fst")

FF_FstHudson_median <- FstHudson_heatmap_data %>% filter(Measure == "median_fst")

FstHudson_htmp_mean <- ggplot(data = FF_FstHudson_mean, 
    aes(x = Focal_pop, y = Comp_pop)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = Value), color = 'white', linewidth = 1.2) +
  
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = 'plasma', na.value = "white") +
  labs(
    x = "Focal Population",
    y = "Compared Population",
    fill = "Mean Fst",
    title = "Mean Fst (Hudson)"
  ) + theme_cowplot()

FstHudson_htmp_median <- ggplot(data = FF_FstHudson_median, 
    aes(x = Focal_pop, y = Comp_pop)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = Value), color = 'white', linewidth = 1.2) +
  
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = 'plasma',na.value = "white") +
  labs(
    x = "Focal Population",
    y = "Compared Population",
    fill = "Median Fst",
    title = "Median Fst (Hudson)"
  ) + theme_cowplot()

print(FstHudson_htmp_mean)
print(FstHudson_htmp_median)
```

#### Fst Hudson Scanplots

```{r}
FF_FstHudson <- FF_FstHudson %>% 
  mutate(
    Comparison = case_when(
      substr(Focal_pop, 1, 1) == "C" & substr(Comp_pop, 1, 1) == "C" ~ "CONvsCON",
      substr(Focal_pop, 1, 1) == "F" & substr(Comp_pop, 1, 1) == "F" ~ "FPvsFP",
      TRUE ~ "CONvsFP"

  ) +

print(FstHudson_scanplots)
```

### linear model for fst comparisons (CON vs FP) and (CON vs CON)

```{r}
FstH_testdata <- FF_FstHudson %>% mutate("mid" = (1 + end)/2) %>% 
  unite("wind_ID", chrom, mid, sep = "_", remove = TRUE) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-start, -end)


FstH_lm <- FstH_testdata %>% 
  group_by(wind_ID) %>% reframe(
    tidy(anova(lm(fst ~ Comparison, data = pick(everything())))),
  ) %>% filter(term == "Comparison")

FstH_lm$adjP <- p.adjust(FstH_lm$p.value, method = 'fdr')

boxplot(FstH_lm$adjP)

```

#### Tukey's post-hoc test

```{r}
FstH_lmsig <- FstH_lm %>% filter(adjP < 0.05)

FstH_tukey <- FstH_testdata %>% semi_join(FstH_lmsig, by = "wind_ID")

sigsites <- unique(FstH_lmsig$wind_ID)
pvals <- FstH_lmsig$p.value

tukeyres <- list()

for(ss in sigsites){
  tempdata <- FstH_tukey %>% 
    filter(wind_ID == ss)
  
  temp_model <- lm(fst ~ Comparison, data = tempdata)
  
  temp_emmeans <- pairs(emmeans(temp_model, specs = ~Comparison, adjust = "tukey"))
  
  temp_emmeans <- tidy(temp_emmeans) %>% mutate(wind_ID = ss, .before = 1)
  
  tukeyres[[ss]] <- temp_emmeans
}

tukeyres <- bind_rows(tukeyres)
tukeyres <- tukeyres %>% 
  dplyr::select(wind_ID, contrast, adj.p.value)
```

#### Scanplot of p-values with Fst comparisons

```{r}
# Combine tibbles containing tukey pval with overall lm p val
Pvalscandata <- FstH_lm %>% 
  dplyr::select(wind_ID, adjP) %>% 
  left_join(tukeyres, by = "wind_ID") %>% 
  rename(pTukey = adj.p.value) %>% 
  mutate(sig_contrast = if_else(pTukey < 0.05, contrast, NA_character_)) %>%
  mutate(sig_contrast = replace_na(sig_contrast, "NotSignificant")) %>% 
  separate_wider_delim(
    cols = wind_ID,
    delim = "_",
    names = c("chromosome", "midwindow")) 

ScanCvFnCvC <- Pvalscandata %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = midwindow, y = -log10(adjP), 
             color = sig_contrast, alpha = -log10(adjP))) +
facet_grid(sig_contrast ~ chromosome, scales = 'free_x', space = 'free_x') +
geom_point() + 
  scale_alpha_continuous(range = c(0.05, 0.6)) +
  #scale_size_continuous(max_size = 3) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), 
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_blank()) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = 'off') +
    labs(y = "-log10(Adjusted P-value", color = "Comparison")

print(ScanCvFnCvC)
```

### Mark target SNPs from linear model tests for CONvsFP Fst

The SNPs are confounded with the 100kb window.

Read target SNP data.

```{r}
target_SNPs <- readRDS("../../../Big_data/lm_targetSNPs.RDS")
```

Make plots

```{r}
target_SNPs <- target_SNPs %>% 
  dplyr::select(CHROM, POS, lm_adjPval)
FstHudson <- FF_FstHudson %>% 
  dplyr::select(chrom, start, end, fst, Comparison)

lmtarget_Fst <- left_join(FstHudson, target_SNPs,
                           by = join_by(
                             chrom == CHROM,
                             start <= POS,
                             end >= POS
                           )) %>% 
  mutate(has_SNP = !is.na(POS))

# Plotting target sites and rest of the sites differently so that points don't overlap and obscure the highlighted points.
lmtarget_Fst_plot <- lmtarget_Fst %>%  
  ggplot(aes(x = start, y = fst)) +
  facet_grid(Comparison ~ chrom) +
  
  geom_point(data = filter(lmtarget_Fst, has_SNP == FALSE),
    color = 'grey', alpha = 0.3, size = 0.5) +

  geom_point(data = filter(lmtarget_Fst, has_SNP == TRUE),
    color = 'red', alpha = 0.8, size = 1) +
  
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom")+
  labs(x = "Window start", y = "Fst (Hudson)")

print(lmtarget_Fst_plot)
```

## Combined plot of Nucleotide diversity and Fst (CONvsFP)

```{r}
# log2 FP/CON ratio of nucleotide diversity
thetapiratio <- FF_thetapi %>% 
  group_by(chrom, start, end) %>% 
  summarise(mCON = mean(theta_pi[Selection == 'CON']),
            mFP = mean(theta_pi[Selection == 'FP']),
            RatioFPCON = log2(mFP/mCON))

# Find 1% outliers, merge with thetapiratio
Rlow <- quantile(thetapiratio$RatioFPCON, 0.01)
Rhigh <- quantile(thetapiratio$RatioFPCON, 0.99)

thetapiratio <- thetapiratio %>% 
  mutate(OutlierRatio = RatioFPCON > Rhigh | RatioFPCON < Rlow)


# Join Fst data (CONvsFP) with Nucleotide diversity ratio (FP/CON)
thetapi_Fst <- lmtarget_Fst %>% 
  filter(Comparison == "CONvsFP") %>% 
  group_by(chrom, start, end, Comparison, POS, lm_adjPval, has_SNP) %>% summarise(mfst = mean(fst)) %>% 
  left_join(thetapiratio, by = c("chrom", "start", "end"))

# Calculate Fst outliers (CONvsFP)
Flow <- quantile(thetapi_Fst$mfst, 0.01)
Fhigh <- quantile(thetapi_Fst$mfst, 0.99)

thetapi_Fst <- thetapi_Fst %>% 
  mutate(OutlierFst = mfst > Fhigh | mfst < Flow)

pal_colors <- palette.colors(palette = "Okabe-Ito")

# Make theta_pi ratio plot again, with lm results integrated
ratio_thetapi_plt <- ggplot(data = thetapi_Fst, aes(x = start, y = RatioFPCON)) +
  facet_grid(.~chrom, scales = 'free_x', space = 'free_x',
             switch = 'x') +
  geom_vline(data = filter(thetapi_Fst, has_SNP),
             aes(xintercept = start), color = 'grey50',
             linewidth = 1.2, alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_point(aes(color = OutlierRatio, alpha = OutlierRatio)) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("FALSE" = pal_colors[8], "TRUE" = pal_colors[4]),
    labels = c("FALSE" = NA, "TRUE" = "1% Outlier")) +
   scale_alpha_manual(values = c("FALSE" = 0.2, "TRUE" = 0.8)) +
  labs(y = bquote("log2(" ~ theta[pi] ~ " Ratio (FP/CON))"),
       x = "Window start") + theme_cowplot() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = 'none',
        strip.background.x = element_blank(),
        strip.placement = 'outside')
  
print(ratio_thetapi_plt)

# Make Fst CONvsFP plot, with lm results integrated
mFst_lm_plt <- ggplot(data = thetapi_Fst, 
                      aes(x = start, y = mfst )) +
  facet_grid(.~chrom, scales = 'free_x', space = 'free_x',
             switch = 'x') +
  geom_vline(data = filter(thetapi_Fst, has_SNP),
             aes(xintercept = start), color = 'grey50',
             linewidth = 1.2, alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_point(aes(color = OutlierFst, alpha = OutlierFst)) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("FALSE" = pal_colors[8], "TRUE" = pal_colors[4]),
    labels = c("FALSE" = NA, "TRUE" = "1% Outlier")) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("FALSE" = 0.2, "TRUE" = 0.8)) +
  labs(y = "Mean Fst (CON vs. FP)",
       x = "Chromosome arm") + theme_cowplot() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = 'none',
        strip.background.x = element_blank(),
        strip.placement = 'outside')
  
print(mFst_lm_plt)
```

### Fst Nei estimator

```{r}
gdalf_fst_nei_path <- "../../../Big_data/grenedalf_fstnei_out"

unlink(gdalf_fst_nei_path, recursive = TRUE)

dir.create(gdalf_fst_nei_path)

grenedalf_fstnei_args <- c(
  "fst",
  "--frequency-table-path", "../../../Big_data/FF_grenedalf_input.csv",
  
  "--pool-sizes", "130",
  
  "--method", "unbiased-nei",
  
  "--window-type", "interval",
  "--window-average-policy", "valid-loci",
  "--filter-sample-min-count", "2",
  "--filter-sample-min-read-depth", "4",
  
  "--window-interval-width", "100000",
  "--window-interval-stride", "100000",
  
  "--out-dir", gdalf_fst_nei_path
  )

system2(
  command = "/home/srikantv/miniforge3/bin/grenedalf",
  args = grenedalf_fstnei_args,
        
  stdout = "../../../Big_data/grenedalf_fstnei_out/gdalf_fstnei_log.txt",
```

### Fst Nei estimator data load, wrangle and plot

```{r}
fstnei_out <- read_csv("../../../Big_data/grenedalf_fstnei_out/fst.csv")

FF_FstNei <- fstnei_out %>% 
  dplyr::select(chrom, start, end, total.passed,
         matches("\\.(passed|fst)"))

FF_FstNei <- FF_FstNei %>% pivot_longer(
  cols = contains(":"),
  
  names_to = c("Focal_pop", "Comp_pop", ".value"),
  
  names_pattern = "(.*?):(.*?)\\.(.*)"
)

if (identical(FF_FstNei$total.passed, FF_FstNei$passed)){
  FF_FstNei <- FF_FstNei %>% dplyr::select(-total.passed)
} else {
  stop("Mismatch between passed values (total vs. specific comparison")
}

FF_FstNei <- FF_FstNei %>% 
  filter(chrom %in% c("2L", "2R", "3L", "3R", "X")) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(fst))

Summary_FstNei <- FF_FstNei %>% group_by(Focal_pop, Comp_pop) %>% 
  summarise(mean_fst = mean(fst), median_fst = median(fst))

all_pops <- sort(unique(c(as.character(Summary_FstNei$Focal_pop), as.character(Summary_FstNei$Comp_pop))))

FstNei_heatmap_data <- Summary_FstNei %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(
    Focal_pop = factor(Focal_pop, levels = all_pops),
    Comp_pop = factor(Comp_pop, levels = all_pops),
  ) %>% 
  
  complete(Focal_pop, Comp_pop) %>% 
  
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(mean_fst, median_fst),
    names_to = "Measure",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    Focal_sel = gsub("[0-9]+$", "", as.character(Focal_pop)),
    Comp_sel = gsub("[0-9]+$", "", as.character(Comp_pop)),
    
    Comparison = case_when(
      Focal_pop == Comp_pop ~ "Self",
      is.na(Value) ~ "Unmeasured",
      Focal_sel == Comp_sel ~ "Within",
      TRUE ~ "Between"
    )
  )

FF_FstNei_mean <- FstNei_heatmap_data %>% filter(Measure == "mean_fst")

FF_FstNei_median <- FstNei_heatmap_data %>% filter(Measure == "median_fst")

FstNei_htmp_mean <- ggplot(data = FF_FstNei_mean, 
    aes(x = Focal_pop, y = Comp_pop)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = Value), color = 'white', linewidth = 1.2) +
  
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = 'plasma', na.value = "white") +
  # 
  # scale_color_manual(
  #   values = c(
  #     "Self" = "transparent",
  #     "Unmeasured" = "transparent",
  #     "Within" = "deepskyblue",
  #     "Between" = "red"
  #   )
  # ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Focal Population",
    y = "Compared Population",
    fill = "Mean Fst",
    title = "Mean Fst (Nei)"
  ) + theme_cowplot()

FstNei_htmp_median <- ggplot(data = FF_FstNei_median, 
    aes(x = Focal_pop, y = Comp_pop)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = Value), color = 'white', linewidth = 1.2) +
  
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = 'plasma', na.value = "white") +
  labs(
    x = "Focal Population",
    y = "Compared Population",
    fill = "Median Fst",
    title = "Median Fst (Nei)"
  ) + theme_cowplot()

print(FstNei_htmp_mean)
print(FstNei_htmp_median)
```

#### Fst Nei Scanplots

```{r}
FF_FstNei <- FF_FstNei %>% 
  mutate(
    Comparison = case_when(
      substr(Focal_pop, 1, 1) == "C" & substr(Comp_pop, 1, 1) == "C" ~ "CONvsCON",
      substr(Focal_pop, 1, 1) == "F" & substr(Comp_pop, 1, 1) == "F" ~ "FPvsFP",
      TRUE ~ "CONvsFP"
    )
  )


FstNei_scanplots <- FF_FstNei %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = start, y = fst, color = Comparison, size = fst)) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 2) +
  facet_grid(Comparison ~ chrom, scales = 'free_x') +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = 'Dark2') +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    x = "Window (100kb) Start Position",
    y = "Fst (Nei)"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(FstNei_scanplots)
```

### Assemble heat maps and save figure

```{r}
Fst_scanfigs <- FstHudson_scanplots/FstNei_scanplots + plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A')

Fst_heatmp_fig <- FstHudson_htmp_mean/FstNei_htmp_mean + 
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A')

print(Fst_heatmp_fig)

ggsave(Fst_scanfigs, filename = "../../Plots/Fst_scanplots.jpeg",
       dpi = 400, width = 8.5, height = 8.5)

ggsave(Fst_heatmp_fig, filename = "../../Plots/Fst_heatmp_fig.jpeg", dpi = 400, width = 8.5, height = 8.5)
```
